You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Recipe Book|TotK}}{{Cite|{{Big|Meat Pie}}
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat Pies are meals made by [[Cooking]] any [[Meat]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The resulting dish, when eaten, will restore some [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. These pies are juicy and contain perfectly baked minced Meat. By adding other ingredients, several different variations of Meat Pie can be made: * '''Chilly Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat Pie}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. If eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat Pie}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. Link gains one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when he eats them. * '''Enduring Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat Pie}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. If they are eaten, they will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat Pie}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. When eaten, they will refill part of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat Pie}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. They can be consumed to provide a boost to Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat Pie}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. Eating these pies will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat Pie}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. Eating them temporarily boosts the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat Pie}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. Link can eat these pies to gain a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat Pie}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. When eaten, these pies grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Meat Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
You'll need an extra napkin to deal with this juicy pie of perfectly baked minced meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. When eaten, Link's defense will be temporarily increased. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Meat Pie is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Really New Recipe]]". It is made using six [[Raw Bird Thigh]]s, six [[Tabantha Wheat]], six [[Goat Butter]]s, and six [[Rock Salt]]s, but this can be lowered to four of each through completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]] will deal 10% more damage. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Meat Pie Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Meat Pie ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Fish Pie * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Pies |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
